verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents a proprietary API, official client libraries, and SDKs, but nothing says any Datadog source is published under an open license. Client libraries and SDKs existing does not show their source is readable under an open license, and nothing covers the core platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
